checks.name: Access Control Vulnerabilities
checks.evidence: 13 state-changing fns: onlyRole on all except finalize (permissionless by design); no tx.origin; AT-2 PASS

checks.name: Price Oracle Manipulation
checks.evidence: no price oracles: amounts come from the approved PO in Module B and are cross-checked by the hub

checks.name: Logic Errors
checks.evidence: state machines in 3 contracts; invariant suite PASS (300 steps, 86 successful tx, 194 reverted, 32 orders, 2 finalized)

checks.name: Lack of Input Validation
checks.evidence: zero-value checks + CP-4 amount/hash cross-check; fuzz suite PASS (13 linked, 14 AmountMismatch, 13 DocHashMismatch)

checks.name: Reentrancy Attacks
checks.evidence: no ETH/token transfers, no low-level calls, no payable/receive/fallback; CEI order

checks.name: Unchecked External Calls
checks.evidence: hub external calls are view-only to immutable module addresses: bank.getPayment, retail.getPO

checks.name: Flash Loan Attacks
checks.evidence: no balances, liquidity or token logic - not applicable

checks.name: Integer Overflow and Underflow
checks.evidence: solc 0.8.28 checked arithmetic, no unchecked blocks, SafeCast for uint64 timestamps

checks.name: Insecure Randomness
checks.evidence: no on-chain randomness; ids are keccak256 of business data

checks.name: Denial of Service (DoS) Attacks
checks.evidence: no unbounded loops in state-changing code (O(1) mappings); pause only by admin; retries + reconciliation (AT-4)
